title: CB3D02 3D three-span box beam, lateral force + torsion
description: 同 CB3D01 几何 + 中跨跨中横向力与扭矩，激活 UY/ROTX/Vy/Mz/T
reference_source: ANSYS 18.0 / BEAM4 (Euler-Bernoulli, SHEARZ=SHEARY=0), frozen *_b4_disp.csv / *_b4_reac.csv / *_b4_elem.csv; each check records its source file, row key and column
theory_note: BEAM188 (Timoshenko, linear shape function) intentionally NOT used as reference: it differs from FEM-Eigen 3D EB by transverse shear. Its results are archived and quantified in *_compare_report.txt [4].
